summary: Graf Global Corp. filed an 8-K on June 26, 2026, reporting non-redemption agreements (NRAs) with certain shareholders covering 4,256,015 Class A ordinary shares. In exchange for not redeeming shares at the meeting to approve an extension amendment, Sponsor Graf Global Sponsor LLC agreed to transfer 425,602 founder shares to them after a business combination closes. NRAs are a common SPAC tactic to preserve trust cash. No deal price, premium, or expected close stated. Watch: shareholder vote on extension and subsequent business combination announcement.
